City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2024 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS – NONE
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the August 21, 2024, Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2024-09-18 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2024-09-18 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Authorizing a grant application for the United States Department of Interior Bureau of Reclamation's WaterSMART Water and Energy Efficiency Grant for the Advanced Metering Infrastructure Phase 1 Project. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Hariri
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-18, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of San Dieguito Water District Authorizing an Application for Grant Funding by the Bureau of Reclamation's WaterSMART Water and Energy Efficiency Grant Program for the Advanced Metering Infrastructure Phase 1 Project"; and 2) Authorize the General Manager, or designee, to apply for funding for the United States Department of Interior Bureau of Reclamation WaterSMART Water and Energy Efficiency Grant for the Advanced Metering Infrastructure Phase 1 Project.
2024-09-18 SDWD Item S08D Grant Application for AMI
8E.
Award a Construction Contract for the Caudor Pressure Regulating Valve and the Leucadia Village Court Pressure Regulating Valve Improvements (CW25C) Project. Environmental Considerations: Pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act, the project is exempt per Section 15301(b) which exempts the minor alteration of existing public structures, facilities, mechanical equipment, and involving no expansion of existing use. The Project would replace existing components of and install minor additions to existing public water infrastructure for system optimization to meet existing fire-flow demand. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
1) Authorize the General Manager to execute a contract in substantial form, and any necessary amendments and time extension in consultation with the Agency Attorney, in the amount of $678,100, plus a 15 percent construction contingency of $101,715 for a total construction contract not-to-exceed amount of $779,815 including any future contract amendments for the construction of the Caudor PRV and the Leucadia Village Court PRV Improvements (CW25C) Project; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-17, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Budget" to amend the FY 2024-25 budget by transferring $779,815 from Project No. CW23C Water Infrastructure Improvements to fund Project No. CW25C Caudor Pressure Regulating Valve and the Leucadia Village Court Pressure Regulating Valve Improvements Project.
2024-09-18 SDWD Item S08E Award Contract for Pressure Regulating Valve CW25C
8F.
Approval of plans and authorization to advertise for the construction of the Encinitas and Cardiff Waterline Looping Project (CW25H). Environmental Considerations: The proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301(c) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion of the existing use. The Encinitas and Cardiff Waterline Looping Project ("Project") is a water maintenance project and therefore, meets the criteria for this exemption. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
1) Approve the plans for the Construction of the Encinitas and Cardiff Waterline Looping Project; 2) Authorize advertisement of the Construction of the Encinitas and Cardiff Waterline Looping Project, (CW25H) for construction bids; and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-16, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Approving the Design and Plans for the Construction of the Encinitas and Cardiff Waterline Looping Project, Pursuant to Government Code Section 830.6".
2024-09-18 SDWD Item S08F Authorize Encinitas and Cardiff Looping Project CW25H
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS – NONE
To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
To speak on informational items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
11A.
Impact of San Diego County Water Authority (SDCWA) Rate Increase on San Dieguito Water District ("District"). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
District Board receive the presentation, review and discuss the information presented as desired, and provide direction to staff as appropriate.
2024-09-18 SDWD Item S11A Impact of SDCWA Rate Increase on SDWD
2024-09-18 SDWD Item S11A Impact of SDCWA Rate Increase on SDWD - Staff Presentation
11B.
Advance Metering Infrastructure (AMI) Implementation Plan. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378 (b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Hariri
Receive and file the AMI Implementation Plan.
2024-09-18 SDWD Item S11B AMI Implementation Plan
2024-09-18 SDWD Item S11B AMI Implementation Plan - Staff Presentation
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON OCTOBER 16, 2024
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
